fix_items: Security boundaries: require approval for `test`/`[ -v` operands in exec allowlist mode, refuse browser proxy commands sent through generic node invoke, fail closed when sandboxed spawned children resolve CLI-backed models, carry `workspaceOnly` into Gateway-built delegate and media tools, keep unresolved Microsoft Teams allowlists restrictive, stop crafted Teams HTML from stalling the Gateway before sender checks, refuse embedded Control UI auth on pinned Android Gateway connections, and audit symlinked workspace skill roots. (#180880, #179880, #178742, #185094, #184989, #183438, #180843, #182384; related #111797) Thanks @eleqtrizit, @RomneyDa, @LeizhenZhang, and @dineshsuthar123. [v2026.10.10-beta.5]

Security: keep browser pairing credentials out of opener process arguments, mask Google OAuth client secrets in logs, redact credentials from MCP CLI inspection, omit credentials from rejected search endpoint errors, and keep malformed piped input from corrupting model credentials. (#170289, #183193, #180321, #182534, #167251; related #180308) Thanks @eleqtrizit, @LeizhenZhang, @RomneyDa, @brandon-julio-t, @wr-web, and @Alix-007. [v2026.10.10-beta.5]

Performance: bound retained session-fork snapshots, release skill catalogs held by prompt reports, coalesce plugin stream transforms, avoid quadratic native reasoning rescans, reduce memory in retrieval, shell analysis, package capture, and history workers, cut stream dispatch copies and unused node event parsing, stop retention work during shutdown, keep cold catalog waits off `plugins.list`, skip settled subagent rechecks and unused activity roster planning, keep large usage reports and incognito transcripts from exhausting workers, and defer dormant Chat streaming code. (#182544, #183010, #185083, #123120, #172392, #183312, #182613, #181936, #183552, #183931, #185859, #179213, #184539, #184921, #181560, #182182, #183407, #156673, #183198) Thanks @RomneyDa, @nierob-cmd, @vincentkoc, @HerbertHuerto, @AmelioMansour, @yy19971996, and @shakkernerd.
